item.title: Solved: Why are 'oradiag_<user>' Folders Showing Up on My Linux System?
item.description:
Solved: Why are “oradiag_” Folders Showing Up on My Linux System?

If you’ve been puzzled by folders like /oradiag_root/, /user/myuser/oradiag_myuser/, or /user/myuser/oradiag_root/ appearing in your Linux directory structure after installing the Zend Framework or Zend Server, you’re not alone. These unexpected folders can cause clutter and confusion. Let’s explore what they are, why they’re created, and most importantly, how to prevent them from reappearing.

Understanding the Cause

These directories, prefixed with oradiag_, are associated with Oracle diagnostics. Specifically, they are created by Oracle’s Automatic Diagnostic Repository (ADR) feature in the SQL*Net component of Oracle 11g and higher. ADR automatically generates folders in your home directory if Oracle client applications, or applications that integrate with Oracle (like Zend Server), don’t find expected logging configurations.
